description: Area facts for one full England postcode, each with its source, edition and licence: council, ward and constituency; rivers-and-sea flood risk; modelled road, rail and aircraft noise bands; Indices of Deprivation. For signed-in Catchmently pass holders it also has crime by type over 12 months, sold prices (postcode, sector, district), house price index and rents, broadband and mobile coverage, nearest stations and stops, nearest GP, shops and parks, surface-water flood risk and Census 2021 detail; without a pass those are marked locked.
name: get_area
title: Area around a postcode
